# Narakeet

> > Narakeet is an AI-powered text-to-speech and video automation platform offering 900+ voices in 100+ languages with PowerPoint and Word integration.

Narakeet enables users to create voiceovers, videos, and audio content from text using advanced AI voice synthesis. The platform supports multimedia formats (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A) and offers specialized voices for diverse use cases including e-learning, IVR systems, and multilingual content creation.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-speech (TTS)
- AI voice generation
- Video automation
- PowerPoint integration
- Word integration
- Multilingual voices (100+ languages)
- Audio formats (MP3, WAV, M4A)
- Video formats (MP4, AVI)
- E-learning content creation
- Voice synthesis
- Speech-to-text transcription
- Subtitle generation
- Indian languages (Marathi, Devanagari)
- Commercial licensing
- Voice customization

## Core Features & Voice Catalog

- [Text to Speech Voices](https://www.narakeet.com/languages): Complete catalog of 900 AI voices across 100 languages and accents
- [Deep Voice Text To Speech](https://www.narakeet.com/create/deep-voice-text-to-speech.html): Deep voice TTS generator with Alfred, Brian, Tony, Rodney voices
- [Connor Text to Speech Scottish Child Voice](https://www.narakeet.com/text-to-speech/voice/connor-ai-voice): Connor: Scottish child AI voice for Edinburgh Castle content and more
- [Voicemail Greeting Generator](https://www.narakeet.com/create/voicemail-greeting-generator.html): Create automated voicemail greetings using AI text-to-speech

## Language-Specific Voice Generators

- [KI Stimmen Generator (German)](https://www.narakeet.com/create/de-ai-stimmen-generator.html): German AI voice generator with Birgit, Dietrich, Kerstin, Jutta voices
- [מחולל קול AI (Hebrew)](https://www.narakeet.com/create/he-ai-voice-generator.html): Hebrew AI voice generator with 900 voices for IVR and e-learning
- [ЖИ аудио генераторы (Kazakh)](https://www.narakeet.com/create/kk-ai-voice-generator.html): Kazakh AI voice generator with 900 voices in 100 languages
- [Voz de Niño IA (Spanish)](https://www.narakeet.com/create/es-generador-de-voz-infantil.html): Spanish child voice generator with Dulce, Conchita for kids content
- [Marathi Text to Speech](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/marathi-text-to-speech): Marathi TTS with Devanagari script support for Maharashtra, India
- [Text To Speech Turkish](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/text-to-speech-turkish): Turkish TTS with Word and PowerPoint integration support
- [Text To Speech Filipino Accent](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/text-to-speech-filipino-accent): Filipino-accented English TTS with Tagalog language support
- [Albanian Text to Speech](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/albanian-text-to-speech): Albanian voiceover for Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro content

## Documentation & Guides

- [Pricing - Premium Text to Speech and Video Automation](https://www.narakeet.com/docs/pricing): Narakeet pricing plans, credits system, and commercial account options
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.narakeet.com/docs/faq): FAQ covering pricing, copyright, PowerPoint, IBM Watson, MS Cognitive
- [Add voice to video](https://www.narakeet.com/docs/add-voice-to-video): Guide for adding voiceovers to videos with timing and pronunciation control
- [Estimate the duration of text to speech](https://www.narakeet.com/docs/how-to/estimate-text-to-speech-duration.html): Calculate TTS audio length using word count and voice speed estimation
- [Make closed captions and subtitles for text to speech audio](https://www.narakeet.com/docs/how-to/create-closed-captions-and-subtitles.html): Generate SRT and WebVTT subtitle files from TTS audio timing data

## Speech-to-Text Services

- [Persian Transcription](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/persian-speech-to-text): Convert Farsi/Persian audio to text in Persian script online
- [Marathi Speech to Text](https://www.narakeet.com/languages/marathi-speech-to-text): Marathi audio transcription to Devanagari script for Maharashtra content
